summary: Join our Value for Money Audit Training Course to master the art of auditing for cost-effectiveness. Gain practical skills to improve financial performance.
lede: Value for money auditing examines how economically resources are used, how efficiently work is delivered and whether activities achieve intended outcomes. It is suited to experienced auditors and oversight professionals assessing program performance. The course covers audit planning, unit-cost benchmarking, logic models and outcome measures, data analysis, root-cause analysis, and reporting findings with follow-up.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for experienced professionals responsible for oversight, governance, and performance improvement in public and private sector entities.
prerequisites: Participants should have at least three years of experience in internal or external auditing, financial management, or public sector oversight. A basic understanding of the IIA® International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF) or INTOSAI standards is recommended. No programming knowledge is required, though familiarity with Microsoft Excel for data analysis is expected.
